# NYC Taxi — Fare Distribution

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Distribution of fare amounts

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    FLOOR(fare_amount / 5) * 5 as fare_bucket,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(trip_distance) as avg_distance,
    AVG(tip_amount) as avg_tip
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2019-11-24'
  AND pickup_datetime < '2019-12-24'
  AND fare_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 100
GROUP BY FLOOR(fare_amount / 5) * 5
ORDER BY fare_bucket
```
